verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static client documentation: a quickstart with Python code snippets and a methods reference listing functions such as run_tasks_until_done and create_task. Nothing documents an interactive API explorer or in-browser runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Static code snippets are an adjacent feature, not an interactive reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
